note: ADR 1051: an action whose first step stops at a plain yield steps again at once inside inTransaction, which flushes when no step is on the stack; called from a createEffect apply that flush runs inside the flush draining effects: FLUSH_IN_EFFECT_CALLBACK at the action call (YieldNumber, BareYield, YieldString), covered by SC2008 violations (no row on main); a yielded promise or binding, an onSettled caller, an async generator and code before the yield have no row. The review's shapes have no row and Chrome is silent at them: an operand that is an operator expression whose text starts and ends with a quote (`||`, `?:`, `+` with a promise or a throw), and a parameter list that throws before the first step (a destructured missing argument, a default that throws)
